Name: (AT) Canon Siamese Cat
Author: Ordospoo
Description:
I’ve always loved Siamese cats, and I adore the canon art style of Stardew Valley. So I made a mod that lets me enjoy both!

This mod adds a Siamese cat that blends seamlessly with the game’s original style.

[list]
[*]It cannot be adopted directly from Marnie as a new pet.
[*]Instead, you can transform any existing cat on your farm into a Siamese cat using the scissors from the Alternative Textures framework, which can be purchased from Robin.
[/list]
I may try to make an adoptable version in the future!
